item.title: Write Instructions for Shared Pool Passes
item.prompt_text: Your group uses four passes for a public pool. Members can collect one from a folder before a session. Each member should move their name from the waiting list to the used list, then return the pass by 7 p.m. Explain what to do if the folder is empty and what to do on a day when the office closes early.
item.audience: new members of a community swimming group
item.target_grammar: Imperatives and if clauses for different conditions.
item.target_structure: Give the normal steps in order, then give both exceptions.

checklist.point: Explain where to collect a pass and how to update the lists.
Say when the pass must normally be returned.
